input.title: Document S3_ENDPOINT and bucket creation for local MinIO setup
input.body:
File: README.md

In the "Running locally" section, step 2 tells readers a MinIO container is the quickest option for the bucket, but doesn't mention that `S3_ENDPOINT` (e.g. `http://localhost:9000`) must be set for uploads to be routed to MinIO instead of AWS S3, nor that the bucket must be created first in the MinIO console. Add a line or two covering both, so a MinIO-based local setup works without needing to search docs/CONFIG.md or the tracker.

text: This confirms it: step 2 of README.md's "Running locally" section mentions MinIO but doesn't say to set `S3_ENDPOINT` (and create the bucket). This is a docs issue.

Add a line or two covering both, so a MinIO-based local setup works without needing to search docs/CONFIG.md or the tracker.

label: docs
file: README.md

The "Running locally" section mentions MinIO as the quickest option in step 2 but never tells the reader to set `S3_ENDPOINT` (documented in docs/CONFIG.md) to point uploads at it, which is why they went to AWS by default. Adding a line about setting `S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000` and creating the bucket first would close this gap.
